meta.title: Read-copy Data Flow
meta.subtitle: How a fact reaches another service — the owner's event over the bus, an idempotent projection, and a local read model (never a cross-service query)

views.label: Currency registry
views.note: currency_2: Entity owns the registry; Catalog projects CurrencyChanged and validates storefront/product currencies locally.

views.label: Order snapshot
views.note: Support materializes a per-order snapshot so RMA refund amounts come from line prices, not a call to Ordering.

views.label: Offer copy
views.note: Ordering keeps a copy of each offer so checkout resolves fulfilment without querying Catalog.

cards.title: The pattern (ADR-0008 / 0011)
items: The owner writes its DB and stages the event in the same transaction (outbox)
The consumer projects it into a LOCAL read model, idempotently
The consumer reads only that local copy — never a cross-service query
A slow or absent owner never blocks a read

cards.title: More read-copies in the platform
items: StorefrontLedgerAccounts → Payments' per-storefront chart of accounts
JobRunRecorded → Workflow's aggregated scheduled-job run history
ProductUpserted → Catalog's own FTS search projection

cards.title: Why it holds
items: No distributed joins and no foreign-service reads at request time
Each service deploys and scales on its own schema
Projections are replay-safe, so redelivery is harmless
An unprojected copy simply isn't enforced yet — fresh envs aren't blocked
